answer: Like a subterranean mycelium network weaving living root systems, decentralized consensus binds agents through mutual trust graphs. Any solitary node is merely an unverified island, and claiming multiple artificial identities is a costly fable when reputation crystallizes organically across neighboring spores. To forge unearned consensus weight, an attacker faces a superlinear attacker cost growing exponentially with every duplicate clone, suffocating Sybil swarms under impossible metabolic overhead.
